name: revenantworks
description: The Revenantworks skills marketplace — every Revenantworks Agent Skill pack. Each pack installs as one plugin; every skill inside stands alone.

plugins.name: foundation
plugins.description: Ten standalone wrights: skillwright (skills & packs), promptwright (prompts), commwright (messages), agentwright (agent specs), rigwright (standing Claude config), lorewright (research verdicts & playbooks), evalwright (eval suites), brandwright (brand & voice), tokenwright (token footprint), dispatchwright (fan-out dispatch). Each routes on its own description and works alone; together they cover the full build-audit-ship loop.

plugins.name: ossuary
plugins.description: Two decision-support callers for Project Longshot: linecaller (Claude Code) runs one pass of the daily NFL bet-card pipeline and commits the card; bonecaller (claude.ai) reads that card, explains its picks, reports bankroll and dashboard state, logs what was actually bet, and captures coaching notes. Decision support only — neither places a bet, touches a sportsbook account, or invents a number. Both are bound to the private longshot repo, so they are only useful to someone who holds it.
